risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: The company is exposed to cyberattack risks but implements structured measures to prevent and detect them.
risks.score_rationale: The company implements cybersecurity measures with a Vice President of Information Security and Privacy reporting to the Audit Committee, but cyberattack risks persist. Threat monitoring, risk assessments, and security control testing are conducted regularly. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.summary: The company is exposed to foreign exchange risks due to its international operations through Kaplan, which may impact its operating income.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to foreign exchange risks, particularly with Kaplan's international operations representing 22% of revenues. A 10% change in exchange rates could impact operating income by $37 million. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.summary: The company is exposed to interest rate fluctuations, which may impact its interest expenses.
risks.score_rationale: The company has fixed and variable rate debt, exposing it to interest rate fluctuations. A 100 basis point increase in interest rates could increase interest expenses by $4.3 million. (default score, to be refined)
